summary: Frontend final validation completed on preview URL and target vehicle route. Direct diagnosis print passed 3/3 consecutive open-close runs within timeout, invoice print from menu passed, and first visit print passed after expanding visit card. QuickPrint preview action buttons (print/WhatsApp/close) remained responsive; no failed /api/documents/generate and no QuickPrintDialog/VehicleDetails console errors were captured.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated generic 401 resource errors still appear in browser console before/around login in preview environment, though required quick-print flows completed successfully in this run.

action_items: Optional hardening: investigate recurring non-blocking 401 bootstrap calls seen in console to reduce auth/session noise in preview.
Keep direct diagnosis button approach as primary trigger; this run met required stability criteria.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleDetails.jsx remains very large (~4.6k lines), increasing regression risk for UI timing/state interactions.
QuickPrintDialog timeout/error handling behaved correctly under this test run; no crash/stuck behavior observed for preview action buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://accounting-ssot-fix.preview.emergentagent.com and /vehicle/ffcf800c-d1bb-40df-8df3-effa59bc05cd. Diagnosis direct button passed 3 consecutive opens with required workshop fields; invoice menu and first visit print succeeded. If retesting visit print, ensure a visit card is expanded to expose visit-print-button selector.
rca of the issue: Previous intermittent diagnosis behavior appears mitigated by introducing the direct always-visible diagnosis button. Earlier visit-print selector timeout in first pass was due to collapsed visit card state (button not visible), not a print generation failure.
